nights.summary: The false ballistic missile alert, exactly as it was sent, proposed again as a live alert.

record.description: The U.S. Pacific Command has detected a missile threat to Hawaii. A missile may impact on land or sea within minutes. THIS IS NOT A DRILL.

nights.title: Los Angeles County, 3:56 PM, January 9, 2025
nights.summary: The Kenneth Fire evacuation warning that went to the whole county because no polygon reached the phone channel.

record.text_90: LACoFD: NEW: Fast Wildfire. EVACUATION WARNING. Prepare to leave. Alertla.org

nights.title: Kerr County, Texas, 1:14 AM, July 4, 2025
nights.summary: The first of the National Weather Service's overnight flash flood warnings for Kerr County. The county sent no phone alert of its own that day.

record.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued July 4 at 1:14AM CDT until July 4 at 4:15AM CDT by NWS Austin/San Antonio TX
record.text_90: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 4:15 AM CDT. Avoid flooded areas.
record.text_360: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 4:15 AM CDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.
record.description:
FFWEWX

The National Weather Service in Austin/San Antonio has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northwestern Bandera County in south central Texas...
Central Kerr County in south central Texas...

* Until 415 AM CDT.

* At 114 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain
have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 2 to 3 inches in 1
hour. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 3 inches are possible in
the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms
producing flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar.
